te: The price of Brent crude oil exceeded $ 108 per barrel for the first time since May 21
de: The cost of November futures for Brent crude oil for the first time since May 21, 2026 exceeded the mark of $ 108 per barrel, TASS reported on September 10, citing trading data from the London exchange ICE.

te: Algeria to close airspace for UAE aircraft
de: From September 11, Algeria will limit the use of its airspace for aircraft registered in the United Arab Emirates. This is stated in a statement by the Ministry of Defense of Algeria, RIA Novosti reported on September 10.
